Paragraph: Unexpanded, undoubtful, undelaying, and non-dissonant is the tenor of his speech, and it comports in his chest or throat in a medium tone.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Rama continues to scrutinize the technical quality of Hanuman's vocal delivery.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Assesses vocal steadiness and clarity as indicators of confidence and truthfulness.
Outcome/Resolution: Adds further weight to Rama's positive appraisal.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Svara-shuddhi (purity and steadiness of vocal tone)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Svara-shuddhi, purity of tone, in Hanuman's speech reflects inner steadiness and truthfulness.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: A steady, non-hesitant, well-modulated voice is read as a marker of composure and absence of deceptive anxiety.
